[RLOW.8.2.1] The call reads the backend state for the fact's own identity
value ([RLOW.8.1.4]). Every aggregation read, in a `where` or on the RHS, sees
the **pre-sample snapshot** per [LSER.8.6.1]: the state as of the start of the
pump, before any sample absorbed in it, not merely before the current fact's
contribution.
